create_FrankaApplianceFixed: create a FrankaApplianceFixed environment with object body names and optional robot joint names
create_FrankaApplianceRandom: create a FrankaApplianceRandom environment that randomizes object positions and robot poses on reset
reset_FrankaApplianceRandom: reset the FrankaApplianceRandom environment with randomized object positions and robot joint states
set_obj_goal: set object goal positions using a dict mapping object names to goal values or a numpy array
set_obj_init: set object initial positions using a dict mapping object names to init values or a numpy array
